code: const list = ssp.objectsTool.getByUserDataProperty('renderType', 'CEILING'); list.forEach(o => ssp.objectsTool.setHighlight(o, '#ff0000', true)); console.log('alarm highlighted', list.length, 'objects (pulse)');
guard: setHighlight 的第三个参数 pulse=true 时每 500ms 切换一次 emissive
要手动取消闪烁调 ssp.objectsTool.clearAllHighlights() (会清掉所有高亮)
